sn54.11:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Icchānaṅgale viharati Icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe || || 2.
sn54.11:1.4: namhi kenaci upasaṅkamitabbo || aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanihārakenā ti || ||
sn54.11:1.5: Evam bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paṭissutvā nāssudha koci Bhagavantam upasaṅkamati aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanihārakena || || 3.
sn54.11:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā tassa temāsassa accayena paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito bhikkhū āmantesi || ||
sn54.11:2.2: Sa ce vo bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam puccheyyuṃ ||
sn54.11:2.3: Katamena āvuso vihārena Samaṇo Gotamo vassāvāsam bahulaṃ vihāsī ti || evam puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesam aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam evam vyākareyyātha ||
sn54.11:2.4: Ānāpānasatisamādhinā kho āvuso Bhagavā vassāvāsam bahulaṃ vihāsī ti || || 4.
sn54.11:2.5: Idhāham bhikkhave sato assasāmi sato passassāmi || || 5--10. Dīgham vā assasanto Dīgham assasāmī ti pajānāmi || dīghaṃ vā passasanto Dīgham passasāmī
sn54.11:2.9: paṭinissaggānupassī Assasissāmī ti pajānāmi || paṭinissaggānupassī Passasissāmī ti pajānāmī || || 11.
sn54.11:3.1: Yañ hi tam bhikkhave sammāvadamāno vadeyya
sn54.11:3.2: ariyavihāro iti pi brahmavihāro iti pi tathagātavihāro iti pi ||
sn54.11:3.4: ariyavihāro iti pi brahmavihāro iti pi tathāgatavihāro iti pi || || 12.
sn54.11:3.5: Ye te bhikkhave bhikkhū sekhā appattamānasā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamānā viharanti || tesam ānāpānasatisamādhi bhāvito bahulīkato āsavānaṃ khayāya saṃvattati ||
sn54.11:3.6: ye ca kho te bhikkhave bhikkhū arahanto khīṇāsavā vusitavanto katakaraṇīyā ohitabhārā anuppattasadatthā parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojanā sammadaññā vimuttā || tesam ānāpānasatisamādhi bhāvito bahulīkato diṭṭheva dhamme sukhavihārāya ceva saṃvattati satisampajaññāya ca || || 13.
sn54.11:4.1: Yañ hi tam bhikkhave sammāvadamāno vadeyya
sn54.11:4.2: ariyavihāro iti pi brahmavihāro iti pi tathāgatavihāro iti pi ||
sn54.11:4.4: ariyavihāro iti pi brahmavihāro iti pi tathāgatavihāro iti pī
